immutable_workflow_verification.rule: For every signed event/checkpoint, git-show the workflow bytes at event.workflow_commit and require SHA256 equality with the signed pre-start manifest path hash.

incremental_checkpoints.critical_path: Verify one signed checkpoint + cheap prefix file digest + Cosign/Rekor only for suffix events.
incremental_checkpoints.full_verification: Required periodically and before any admission decision.

event_invariants.uniqueness: (type,head,slot) must be unique for forecast, delivery, outcome and missed events; schedule/freeze unique per head.

volatility_episodes.note: Values are fixed before successor prospective launch and are not tuned on R7 outcomes.

tail_magnitude_research.target_unit: multiples of frozen R6 volatility barrier
